color.note: Paper is the default mode; Evening is the AR camera mode. Gold is a line, never a fill. Ruby is the one primary action.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Paper ivory. The Paper-mode ground and the Evening-mode text colour. Never tinted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ink. Paper-mode text (15.5:1 on ivory, 13.6:1 on pearl) and the Evening-mode ground.

tokens.name: pearl
tokens.usage: Pearl mist. Quiet surfaces in Paper mode: product plinths, sheets' inner panels, disabled fills.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Muted 18k gold. Hairlines and small accents ONLY: rules, dividers, the link underline, selected rings. Never a fill, never a gradient, never text. 3.05:1 on ivory (decorative); 5.07:1 on ink.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Added for AA. The same gold, one step deeper, for any gold line that carries meaning in Paper mode (control borders, focus rings): 4.28:1 on ivory, 3.77:1 on pearl. Still a line, never a fill.

tokens.name: ruby
tokens.usage: Kundan ruby. The primary call to action, once per view. Ivory label on it is 9.84:1.

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: Deep emerald. Secondary emphasis: confirmed states, 'Looking good', a secondary accent in editorial layouts. 9.31:1 on ivory.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Stone. Secondary text at 24px+ only in Paper mode (3.31:1 on ivory); fine at any size in Evening (4.68:1 on ink). Disabled labels.

tokens.name: stone-deep
tokens.usage: Added for AA. Secondary text below 24px in Paper mode: 5.64:1 on ivory, 4.97:1 on pearl.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen ground.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Quiet raised areas without elevation: sheet panels, table stripes, pressed secondary buttons, disabled fills.

tokens.name: surface-control
tokens.usage: Control backgrounds. Evening: translucent ink over the live camera (no blur, no glass). Text on it is always `text` (ivory), 10:1 even over a white camera frame; gold rings on it hold 3.3:1.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text, on `surface`, `surface-alt` and `surface-control`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, small-caps labels, on `surface` and `surface-alt` (Paper 5.6:1 / 5.0:1; Evening 6.4:1 on ink). Not on the camera: use `text` there.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast minimums; always paired with a non-colour cue).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on a `text`-coloured fill: selected chips and segments, the toast.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative gold rules: section dividers, spec-table rules, sheet top edge, link underline. Replaces elevation.

tokens.name: hairline-quiet
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis separators where gold would be too much (list rows, input groups). Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls: secondary button, inputs, chips, segmented control, swatch rings. 3:1+ on every surface in both modes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, 2px outside the control. 4.28:1 on ivory, 3.77:1 on pearl, 5.07:1 on ink.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill. Once per view.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary CTA on hover (ivory label 8.5:1).

tokens.name: action-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary CTA while pressed (ivory label 12.2:1).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `action`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary accent and positive status, as text or a small mark, on `surface` (Paper 9.3:1; Evening 7.7:1).

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on a `secondary` fill.

tokens.name: status-positive
tokens.usage: Positive status mark and text ('Looking good', 'Booked'). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-attention
tokens.usage: Attention mark ('Move a little closer'). A mark, never body text.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error text and input error border (Paper 9.8:1; Evening 8.4:1 on ink). Always with an icon and a sentence.

tokens.name: metal-yellow
tokens.usage: Yellow-gold metal swatch. Representational only. Swatches only, never UI chrome; always inside a `control-line` ring so light stones read on ivory.

tokens.name: metal-white
tokens.usage: White-gold metal swatch. Representational only. Swatches only, never UI chrome; always inside a `control-line` ring so light stones read on ivory.

tokens.name: metal-rose
tokens.usage: Rose-gold metal swatch. Representational only. Swatches only, never UI chrome; always inside a `control-line` ring so light stones read on ivory.

tokens.name: gem-diamond
tokens.usage: Diamond swatch base; facets drawn over it in ink at low opacity. Swatches only, never UI chrome; always inside a `control-line` ring so light stones read on ivory.

tokens.name: gem-ruby
tokens.usage: Ruby swatch base (the stone, not the CTA). Swatches only, never UI chrome; always inside a `control-line` ring so light stones read on ivory.

tokens.name: gem-emerald
tokens.usage: Emerald swatch base. Swatches only, never UI chrome; always inside a `control-line` ring so light stones read on ivory.

tokens.name: gem-sapphire
tokens.usage: Sapphire swatch base. Swatches only, never UI chrome; always inside a `control-line` ring so light stones read on ivory.

tokens.name: gem-pearl
tokens.usage: Pearl swatch base; one flat highlight, no facets. Swatches only, never UI chrome; always inside a `control-line` ring so light stones read on ivory.

tokens.name: gem-polki
tokens.usage: Polki (uncut diamond) swatch base; broad irregular flat facets. Swatches only, never UI chrome; always inside a `control-line` ring so light stones read on ivory.
